easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Sceptre of Eternal Glory that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 2.
